description: Fraud/security view of an IP: is it a VPN, proxy, Tor exit, datacenter/hosting, or mobile network, plus is_abuser (listed on a public abuse blocklist: botnet C2, reported attackers, hijacked netblocks) with the matching lists and the abuse contact of the network, a 0-100 risk score and a one-line assessment. Answers "is this IP an anonymizer / bot / datacenter, or a clean residential IP?". Keyless.

ip.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address to assess, e.g. "8.8.8.8" or "185.220.101.1".
